candidates.defline: Order holds your chart’s strongest seat: your prime is an office held with honor.
candidates.reading: This position rules Career and Growth from the strongest seat there is. Your prime years belong to institutions: responsibility arrives early, titles fit, and your name becomes a small standard others measure by. You succeed by being dependable at scale. The hazard is calcification, order kept for its own sake while the mission quietly leaves. Re-read the mission yearly. You were made an officer to serve something. Keep remembering what.
